Facts:
- The Saturn AL-31 is a family of military turbofan engines.
- Currently, the Saturn AL-31 powers all Sukhoi Su-27 derivatives and the Chengdu J-10 multirole jet fighter developed by China.
- The Chengdu J-10, NATO reporting name Firebird, is a lightweight all-weather multirole fighter aircraft with a delta wing, canard configuration, and fly-by-wire flight controls.
- Chengdu Aircraft Corporation in China produces the Chengdu J-10 for the People's Liberation Army Air Force.
- All members of the Sukhoi S-54 family resemble the Sukhoi Su-27 or, more closely, the Sukhoi Su-33 in general form.
- The Sukhoi S-54 family is built around a single Saturn AL-31 engine rather than two and is scaled down to a smaller layout.
